extraction.Name: Armine Turgeon
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by the Citizen State Bank of Bonesteel on July 20, 1920
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged; foreclosure proceedings and sheriff's certificate of sale to the Federal Land Bank was executed March 14, 1928
extraction.Buyer: Federal Land Bank; mortgage by Armine and Benjamin Turgeon for $18,000.00; sheriff's certificate of sale executed March 14, 1928
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612831 issued; land described as Lots 3 and 4 and the east half of the southwest quarter, the west half of the northeast quarter, the east half of the northwest quarter of section 31, township 97, range 69; the south half of section 25, township 97, range 70; receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 14, 1918; on February 23, 1925 Armine and Benjamin Turgeon mortgaged this and some other land for $18,000.00; foreclosure proceedings and sheriff's certificate of sale to the Federal Land Bank executed March 14, 1928; time for redemption expired March 14, 1929; also referenced as allotment 972 at top of document
